title: Assign orders to staff
problem: Big shops could not split confirming and packing between staff.
now: Each order can be given to a staff member, in bulk too, and each person has an Assigned to me view.
steps: Tick two orders and press Assign
Open the Assigned to me tab
notes: Where: Orders › All orders (select › Assign, Assigned to me tab); order page › Assigned to

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
